write_to_logbook.title: 'Galactic Occupations: behaviour active'
write_to_logbook.text: '%1 is running %2. This confirms the order started; completion and payment are recorded separately.'.[$ship.knownname, $ship.order.name]

do_if.value: player.age ge @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_combat_until or not $ship.isplayerowned or not Init.$Orders.indexof.{@$ship.defaultorder.id} or $ship.hullpercentage lt 55 or $ship == player.occupiedship

set_value.name: player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_status
set_value.exact: if @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_combat_order.exists and $ship.order == player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_combat_order then 'Intercepting convoy threat; occupation will resume' else 'Occupation paused while another order or player control is active'

do_if.value: $ship.isplayerowned and @$ship.order.id == 'VGO_taxi' and $station.isoperational and @$ship.dock.container == $station and $ship.people.free and not (player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_passenger? and @$ship.people.{player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_passenger}.exists)
$entry.$moving and $actor.exists and not $actor.iswalking and @$entry.$walksignal + 15s lt player.age

set_value.name: player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_status
set_value.exact: 'Taxi: docked, ' + $aboard + '/' + player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_passengers.count + ' passengers boarded' + (if $waiting then ' - waiting for walkable interiors' else '')

set_value.name: $arrived
set_value.exact: (@$entry.$arrived or ($actor.exists and $actor.hascontext.{$station} and not $actor.hascontext.{$ship})) and not ($actor.exists and $actor.hascontext.{$ship})

set_value.name: player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_status
set_value.exact: 'Passenger service: docked, ' + $completed + '/' + player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_passengers.count + ' passengers left the ship' + (if $waiting then ' - waiting for a valid room or movement path' else '')

do_if.value: $ship.isplayerowned and $ship != player.occupiedship and $ship.order == $ship.defaultorder and Init.$Orders.indexof.{@$ship.order.id} and $ship.order.isparameditable.home and @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_runtime != 31 and not @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_hack_phase

check_value.value: player.entity.$vardath_income? and player.entity.$vardath_income.count gt 0 and (not player.entity.$vardath_income_logged_seq? or @player.entity.$vardath_income_seq gt player.entity.$vardath_income_logged_seq)

write_to_logbook.title: 'Vardath Payment: ' + $receipt.{4}
write_to_logbook.text: '%1; %2; paid %3; receipt #%4; original game time %5 seconds'.[$receipt.{7}, $receipt.{8}, $receipt.{5} * 1Cr, $receipt.{1}, $receipt.{2}]

set_value.name: $status
set_value.exact: if @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_status then player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_status else 'Waiting for occupation worker'

set_value.name: $last
set_value.exact: if @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_stats.{$job}.$last_success then player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_stats.{$job}.$last_success else 'None recorded since diagnostics update'

set_value.name: $report
set_value.exact: '%1 | %2 | Status: %3 | Sector: %4 | Target: %5 | Destination: %6 | Task cycles started: %7; completed assignments: %8; received: %9'.[$ship.knownname + ' [' + $ship.idcode + ']', readtext.{191180}.{100 + $job}, $status, if $ship.sector.exists then $ship.sector.knownname else 'In transit or unavailable', if $target.exists then $target.knownname else 'None selected', if $destination.exists then $destination.knownname else 'None selected', $started, $completed, $income] + ' | Last completed work: ' + $last

set_value.name: $report
set_value.exact: $report + ' | Crystal items forwarded to player inventory: ' + (if @player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_crystal_sent then player.entity.$vgo_objects.{$ship}.$vgo_crystal_sent else 0)

write_to_logbook.title: 'Galactic Occupations 0.3.1 registry ready'
write_to_logbook.text: '13 occupations registered. Galactic Station Hacker uses existing crew, real native panels, remotely reserved tools and physical crew return. Missing tools retry every 10 game minutes. Foreign-trader patrol arrivals now pay 8,000 Cr after verified protection; balance-confirmed receipts are recorded in General. New hacker interactions require in-game validation with your station interiors.'

write_to_logbook.title: 'Galactic Occupations 0.3.1 loaded'
write_to_logbook.text: 'Station hack submenu now rebuilds on replies, polls for missed replies and offers a paused-safe timeout/retry. Crystal miners can follow permitted active simulation, recover actual loose crystal drops and retry native pickup directly to the player ship. No crystals are generated. Use the new search/fire/pickup diagnostics to verify real harvesting.'
